title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → ExperientialLearning

source_tables.description: Registrations. Rows for experiential sections become HELIX ExperientialLearning.
Class section: SSR_COMPONENT identifies internship, practicum, clinical, field, and research components. FLAG: component codes are local (delivered examples include CLN, PRA, FLD, RSC).
Study abroad registrations, usually identified by a location, session, or placeholder course. FLAG: local practice varies.

notes: The ERP knows about credit-bearing experiences (internship, practicum, clinical, student teaching, research, study abroad courses). Employer, supervisor, pay, and evaluations usually live in the career services platform; see bridge/outcomes/handshake_experiential_learning_mapping.json and merge the two in silver on student + term + course.
